plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Hirschmann HiOS switch (HM2-DIAGNOSTIC-MIB / HM2-DEVMGMT-MIB / HM2-PWRMGMT-MIB, enterprise PEN 248). It reports uptime, CPU utilization, RAM used/free/total and utilization, device temperature, power supply state, and interface traffic. Applies to HiOS devices whose sysObjectID starts with 1.3.6.1.4.1.248.11; Classic 1.3.6.1.4.1.248.14 devices use switch_hirschmann. CPU and memory are empty if hm2DiagEnableMeasurement is disabled on the device.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Current CPU utilization of the Hirschmann HiOS switch (HM2-DIAGNOSTIC-MIB hm2DiagCpuUtilization, 0-100 percent). Empty when hm2DiagEnableMeasurement is disabled on the device.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: RAM utilization of the Hirschmann HiOS switch, computed at collection time as allocated / (allocated + free) * 100 from hm2DiagMemoryRamAllocated and hm2DiagMemoryRamFree. Empty when hm2DiagEnableMeasurement is disabled on the device.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total RAM of the Hirschmann HiOS switch in bytes. The MIB has no total object, so it is computed at collection time as allocated + free (kBytes x 1024).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Allocated RAM of the Hirschmann HiOS switch in bytes (HM2-DIAGNOSTIC-MIB hm2DiagMemoryRamAllocated, kBytes converted to bytes at collection time).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free RAM of the Hirschmann HiOS switch in bytes (HM2-DIAGNOSTIC-MIB hm2DiagMemoryRamFree, kBytes converted to bytes at collection time).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Current device temperature of the Hirschmann HiOS switch in degrees Celsius (HM2-DEVMGMT-MIB hm2DevMgmtTemperature).

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power supply state of the Hirschmann HiOS switch (HM2-PWRMGMT-MIB hm2PSState, indexed by hm2PSID), normalized so that present/notInstalled = 1 (normal) and defective/unknown = 2 (abnormal). Empty slots keep a row.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
